snippet.title: Echo Weaver | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Echo Weaver on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/

Echo Weaver is a time loop metroidBRAINia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. You're the last of the Weavers, a remnant of a ruined society trapped in a glitching time loop. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

To learn more about Echo Weaver, Akupara Games, and Moonlight Kids visit:
